expected_issues.title: Hardcoded Secrets in Source Code
expected_issues.message: DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET are hardcoded in source code, exposing credentials if the repository is leaked or shared.
expected_issues.suggestion: Load secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager.
expected_issues.resolution_example:
import os
DATABASE_URL = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]
JWT_SECRET = os.environ["JWT_SECRET"]
